collection: Farnsworth Motors / US bestsellers / 2018–2024 model years
purpose: Illustrative sample inventory assets, not photographs of actual stock
selectionMethod: Twenty high-volume US-market nameplates represented in bestseller lists from the 2018–2024 period. Each image depicts a chosen model year within that range. This is a curated set, not a computed cumulative 2018–2024 sales ranking. Truck-family sales commonly combine light- and heavy-duty variants; images depict the named light-duty variant.

sources.title: Car and Driver: The Best-Selling Cars, Trucks, and SUVs of 2018
Car and Driver: Top 25 Bestselling Cars, Trucks, and SUVs of 2021
Car and Driver: The 25 Bestselling Cars, Trucks, and SUVs of 2024

commonPrompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: Farnsworth Motors website inventory card, one individual vehicle image in a coordinated 20-image catalog.
Scene/backdrop: empty premium photographic studio, seamless warm charcoal gray cyclorama and matte graphite concrete floor, subtle soft grounded shadow; no visible horizon seam, architecture, props, scenery, or other vehicles.
Style/medium: convincingly photorealistic professional automotive catalog photography, precise factory body proportions and realistic materials. Understated premium restraint, not a flashy advertisement.
Composition/framing: landscape 1536x1024 composition. Full vehicle from front driver-side three-quarter view, nose pointing toward left of frame, camera about headlamp height, 55mm lens, mild perspective. Car centered horizontally and fills about 79 percent of frame width, all bumpers tires roof and mirrors inside frame with generous crop-safe margins; tire contact line near 79 percent image height. Show front fascia and driver side clearly, level wheels pointing straight.
Lighting/mood: broad overhead softbox and soft front fill, subtle long pale reflections along body, enough illumination to read the grille and tire detail against darker background; controlled restrained contrast, natural paint, no crushed-black bodywork, dry matte floor without mirror reflection.
Constraints: exactly one factory-stock US-market vehicle; correct model-year generation, recognizably accurate front fascia, body silhouette, lamps and factory-style wheels. Original manufacturer emblems may be present naturally. Unoccupied, closed doors/windows/hood/tailgate, parked, immaculate finish, lights off. No rendered caption, price, inventory label, graphic frame, logo overlay, watermark, dealership branding, readable plate, people, extra cars, aggressive modifications, fog, smoke, orange glow or oversaturated HDR.
